associations.event: Burgett replaces Winter as Foxtrot CO
associations.originalReading:
2 NOVEMBER 1965                   First Lieutenant D. G. WINTER was relieved as CO,
                                  "F" Company by First Lieutenant G. S. BURGETT.
associations.replacement:

associations.event: Reinforced Golf platoon participates in Operation Tendertouch
associations.originalReading:
3-5 NOVEMBER 1965                 PARTICIPATED IN OPERATION TIMBERTORCH
                                  The 1st Platoon (Rein), "G" Co, under the command
                                  of 2ndLt W. W. JAFFKE participated as aggressors
                                  in the U.S. Army Operation Timbertorch which was
                                  conducted by the 3rd Brigade, 5th Infantry Divi-
                                  sion (Mechanized), Fort Carson, Colorado, at Marine
                                  Corps Base, Camp Pendleton, California.
associations.replacement:
